description: This file defines the PhpSelection class, an alternative entity reference selection plugin in Drupal that uses PHP for advanced filtering of entities based on labels, with methods for retrieving and counting referenceable entities and matching labels.

classes.name: PhpSelection
classes.description: An entity reference selection plugin class that provides advanced filtering capabilities for referenceable entities in Drupal.

methods.name: getReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities that can be referenced, filtered by a match string and operator, with optional limit.

methods.name: countReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Counts the total number of referenceable entities matching the criteria.

methods.name: matchLabel
methods.description: Determines if an entity label matches a given value based on the specified operator.
